notes.text:
This update for s390-tools fixes the following issues:

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2025-3416: Fixed Use-After-Free in Md::fetch and Cipher::fetch in rust-openssl crate. (bsc#1242622)

Other issues:

- Added the new IBM z17 (9175) processor type.

notes.text: A flaw was found in OpenSSL's handling of the properties argument in certain functions. This vulnerability can allow use-after-free exploitation, which may result in undefined behavior or incorrect property parsing, leading to OpenSSL treating the input as an empty string.
